deliveryNotes: All required runtime image files are bundled locally. Original large generator PNG intermediates are intentionally excluded from submission; final optimized exports are complete.
Animated WebP assets are decorative. Render corresponding static fallback for reduced-motion users, offscreen sections, unsupported animation, or paused effects.
Atmospheric animation never communicates a reward or transaction confirmation. Reward celebration must be controlled by confirmed application state.
